reciprocityLaw: Every trace names at least one existing case; every case and mutation control belongs to at least one trace; a case lists a trace id exactly when that trace lists the case id; every evidence owner is a named future test file for V2/build (or this package's own static test for authority-integrity).

traces.requirement: Identical input, engine version, and cost/search/tie-break policy yield byte-identical alternatives, ordering, and counters under every quantum schedule.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead success criteria and REBUILD_PLAN 11.9/12.1 determinism laws

traces.requirement: Small cases equal exhaustive brute force: the beam result matches full chain enumeration in front content, selection, and ordering.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead success criteria (brute-force oracle tests)

traces.requirement: Weak dominance prunes only within a bucket during search and across chains only at the final front; equal vectors never dominate; the front contains exactly the non-dominated chains.
The frozen total order is aggregate axes lexicographically, then the unique candidate-id sequence; selection is its minimum.
Cross-bucket dominance is never applied before the final layer; a locally worse prefix may carry the global optimum.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 12.6 (no greedy optimization from the previous chord only)

traces.requirement: Manual/Frozen events contribute exactly one immutable candidate whose pitches survive bit-for-bit; constraint violations on fixed candidates are preserved and degraded, never repaired.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead (Manual/Frozen seams) and REBUILD_PLAN 12.6 boundaries

traces.requirement: Reset boundaries split independent chains; no transition cost crosses a reset; the aggregate cost folds across segments by the frozen per-axis aggregation.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 12.6 (section reset starts a new chain)

traces.requirement: Loop closure folds each chain's last-to-first transition before the final front, drops refused chains, applies only to single-segment single-window requests, and is otherwise skipped with a visible degradation.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 12.6 (loop boundaries may include last-to-first transition cost)

traces.requirement: Family/range/bass filters run in the frozen order charging the first failing kind; locks travel verbatim to the oracle; impossible constraints yield a typed no-realization naming every responsible constraint; nothing is silently relaxed.
Every refusal code fires from its dedicated near-miss with the documented JSON pointer, and validation precedence resolves multi-fault requests deterministically.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead (malformed cases) and the Section 4 precedence table

traces.requirement: The 96/24 upstream caps, beam width 48, 512-event window, 8,192-event request cap, 7-lock cap, and quantum arithmetic hold exactly at their edges.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead (96/24/48/512 bound cases) and REBUILD_PLAN 12.6

traces.requirement: Charts beyond 512 events optimize as consecutive windows with fixed boundary voicings, a window-partition degradation, exhausted termination, and window realizations covering only their own events.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 12.6 (explicit 512-event windows with fixed boundary voicings)

traces.requirement: The Section 9 state machine holds: initialize consumes no quanta, each advance exactly one, terminal states refuse resume/cancel, tampered pins refuse as stale, and quantum boundaries are invisible in observables.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead (cancellation/resume/yield-schedule equivalence) and REBUILD_PLAN 11.9 stepper law

traces.requirement: Cancelled and work-quanta-cap outcomes return diagnostics and counters only, never a partial option set.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 11.9 (user cancellation produces no partial option set)

traces.requirement: All fourteen work counters and four memory counters follow the frozen operational definitions, satisfy the work-unit identity, and stay within the frozen limits.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead (memory/work counters; SearchStats) and REBUILD_PLAN 11.9 SearchStats

traces.requirement: V2 consumes transition facts only through the injected V1 operation with per-pair memoization; oracle refusals exclude pairs or name lock conflicts; V2/build must add integration tests against the real assignVoiceTransition.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead (resumable optimizer over V1 motion/cost vectors) and V1 contract handoff

traces.requirement: The fixture package itself is mutation-sensitive: manifest constants match the frozen module, trace reciprocity holds, and provenance flags cannot flip silently.
traces.parentSource: V2 bead exit criteria (mutation-sensitive contract, independent authorship)
